n1ebc48bfbb.headline: Electricity price increase: will tariffs rise from June 1?
n1ebc48bfbb.summary: Ukraine's electricity tariffs for households remain relatively low due to a special obligations mechanism, but discussions about raising prices have been ongoing for months.
n1ebc48bfbb.why: Electricity tariffs affect household expenses and industrial costs, influencing inflation and economic stability in Ukraine.
